infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Tide reads your sleep, steps, and heart rate data to help identify patterns with your symptoms.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Tide can write symptom data back to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Tide uses Face ID to protect your private health data.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationUsageDescription: Tide sends daily reminders to help you stay consistent with your symptom tracking.
